title: Firefly-Geni LLM-assisted generative framework proposes TADF molecules, one synthesized
summary: Firefly-Geni uses LLM-assisted literature data extraction, a multitask property predictor, a conditional molecular generator and quantum-chemical feedback. From 100,000 molecules generated for a singlet-triplet gap of 0.05 eV and synthetic accessibility score 2.5, it identified 100 structurally novel candidates predicted computationally to support reverse intersystem crossing. One synthesized candidate showed an experimental singlet-triplet gap of 0.019 eV and a film photoluminescence quantum yield of 84% under nitrogen, broadly consistent with predictions. Only one molecule was synthesized.
ai_technology: LLM-assisted data extraction, multitask property prediction and conditional molecular generation with quantum-chemical feedback

evidence.tested: One generated candidate was synthesized and its singlet-triplet gap and film quantum yield measured.
evidence.unknown: Experimental performance of the other 99 candidates and device-level behavior; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Generative and predictive models proposed the candidate molecules.
